title: Battle of Sanandaj
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Sanandaj", at revision 1374538240, opens: "The Battle of Sanandaj was a battle in the Ottoman–Persian War (1776–1779). On May 5, 1777, an Ottoman force under the command of Babanlı Mehmed Pasha, the governor of Baban, inflicted a defeat on the Persian army under Khosrow Khan, the governor of Sanandaj of the Zand Dynasty, at Sanandaj." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q118929919, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1777 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
